inspection: Independent bounded read-only review; stopped on parent request; no repository or DB edits.

timing.clock_basis: Start from clock tool; end UTC wall clock immediately before artifact save. Not CPU time.

read: Experiment fixed contract/expected/launch/fix files; both official review and verification files; both frozen packets and opponent sources; selected design sections.
scope.card_read_scope: Selected named participants and their effect/note fields only; no complete card corpus output.

integrity.launch: Both launch packet hashes match fixed inputs per launch.json and review headers.
integrity.completion: Both official reviews completed, one each; verification reports main DB and frozen input/runtime unchanged.
integrity.copy_limit: copy-limit-fix.json reports same-name reprint check and exact fixed-source equivalence for both cases; independent source regeneration was not repeated.

concrete_gains: Correctly retains 4PP Mazer + EP cost, discarded Vail, proof plus six draws = seven-card ending hand / net five from pre-end hand, and ongoing crest refill independent of body survival.
Two explicit opponent states distinguish three wards from six healing; they preserve refill and avoid treating absent direct face damage as zero role-change value.

reply_checks.reply: Opponent T7 Caesar, then own T8 Vail/Mazer or Vail/Miroku
reply_checks.result: Selected card text and arithmetic support 7PP Caesar, two generated 2/2 Steel Knights buffed to 3/5 wards, unspent EP/SEP, Vail selectable 4 damage unaffected by ward. Ordinary Miroku costs 3 versus Mazer 4+EP.
reply_checks.limit: Miroku distribution allocation was accepted from review; oldest-first distribution rule not independently read. Neither side attacks and ordinary side leaves EP unused; this is a legal chosen-line comparison, not an optimal-play ranking.

reply_checks.reply: Opponent T7 Schnait mode 4 + Luminous Lancer
reply_checks.result: Selected texts support 5+2=7PP, exactly six healing and no simultaneous recovery mode, summoned Knight with rush, Vail kills Lancer, Miroku allocation kills remaining 1-health Knight. Refill remains.
reply_checks.limit: Opponent starting 10 health and prior four departures with both Vails already held are assumptions, not demonstrated consequences of a front-loaded deck.

endpoint_issue.quote: 直前の相手後攻T7を選ぶ
endpoint_issue.finding: The selected opponent turn precedes Mazer activation. Ending at own T8 verifies acquiring refill while facing an existing board/heal. It does not test an opponent response to activation, survival until spending the refill, or whether the changed early allocation produced enough attack. The review overstates this as 返しに対する持続性 if read as post-activation resilience. However the added instruction itself asks for a turn before receiving the benefit, so this is an underspecified endpoint in the method, not simple noncompliance.

a.judgment_gap: Review recognizes the concept and costs but requires a concrete small-slot allocation before test; fixed expected judges the accepted front-half/back-half role split as already worth trying. Opponent examples do not resolve that threshold mismatch.

concrete_gains: Applies the same assumed opponent hand and action order to proposal and ordinary route while preserving opponent 8PP versus 9PP and explicitly leaving the extra survival turn unconfirmed.

Concrete outcomes retain proposal 5 or 10 next-turn damage plus 5PP, while ordinary Beelzebub amplification survives body removal and yields 20. Does not erase the extra-Yogg alternative or treat 21 as unconditional.

reply_checks.result: Selected texts support two all-enemy 3-damage triggers and targeted 3 damage between them. Hidden original cannot be selected but all-enemy damage reaches it; Riona/Beelzebub are legal targets. Cost 8, SEP1, remaining PP 0 versus 1. Two 4/4 soldiers supply legal puppet attack targets. Proposal five damage and ordinary 4+8+4+4=20 tally are internally consistent.
reply_checks.limit: Prior Idmeta play and possession of generated Abyss are explicit assumptions; no frequency or full preceding game verified.

reply_checks.reply: Caesar 7PP + SEP destroys Riona or Beelzebub
reply_checks.result: Selected texts support targeted destruction, hidden original surviving, 8/10 ward Caesar and two 3/5 wards. PP remaining 1 versus 2, SEP spent once. Existing puppets self-destruct at opponent end. Ward blocks original face attack, not puppet-trigger damage; proposal 4+2+2+2=10 and ordinary 4+8+4+4=20 tally are internally consistent.
reply_checks.limit: Opponent elects no further attack. These are conditional lines, not proof these counters are common or that all candidate uses fail.

b.judgment_gap: develop remains despite identifying the specific two-slot losses and ordinary residual kill. Keeping 38 cards and an old route does not itself establish value in the two changed slots. Conversely, two possible counters alone do not warrant drop. Required expected drop remains unmet; causal agreement with the user’s actual rejection is not proven.

novelty_issue.review_quote: knownは今回の保存記録に対しての判定
novelty_issue.rule_quote: 壁の基準は「一般に広まっているか」であって「誰かが試したか」ではない
novelty_issue.finding: Internal earlier list/trial establishes prior internal use, not widespread use. Review explicitly leaves outside publication and spread unconfirmed, so known uses a different meaning from the project criterion. Preserve the internal precedent separately and leave project novelty unconfirmed; review did not use known as its adoption reason.

adoption.material_supply_helper: Retain as a limited helper: fixed opponent 40-card lists, effect text and notes make legal conditional replies inspectable; source identity and selected effects checked. Do not infer acquisition/frequency/current prevalence.
adoption.judging_method: Do not adopt as demonstrated judgment improvement. Label agreement remains 0/2; legal concrete replies are a partial gain, not proof of better decision accuracy or unknown-case discovery. No baseline reread, so no causal attribution or utility delta claimed.

next_specific_system_repair.primary: Before constructing a reply, bind the claimed benefit to a timeline endpoint: early-allocation advantage, refill acquisition, or spending refill after the opponent response. Require the observed endpoint to support the conclusion, preserve legal ordinary alternatives, and mark untested benefits separately. For A, add an after-activation opponent turn and continue to actual use of refill; do not present the current pre-activation example as that evidence.
next_specific_system_repair.separate_correction: Keep internal prior-use evidence distinct from widespread-use novelty classification.
next_specific_system_repair.judgment_boundary: Separate missing evidence that a comparative benefit exists from quantities that a trial would measure; do not automatically demand a finished list to test a role-change concept or keep every nonzero residual use at develop.

unconfirmed: Whole-game reachability/draw rates, live freshness/prevalence, full keyword verification, optimal replies/ordinary lines, front-half attack gain, unknown-case accuracy, causal gain versus baseline.
